DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お茶を入れる前に、茶碗を両手で持ってみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before adding tea, let's try holding the bowl with both hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この茶碗の内側に細い線があります。模様なのか、ひびなのかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 茶碗の線がひびかどうか講師に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a thin line inside this bowl. I don't know whether it's a pattern or a crack.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the instructor whether the bowl's line is a crack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今はその茶碗を置いておきましょう。指で線をなぞらず、どこにあるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's put that bowl down for now. Don't trace the line with your finger; tell me where it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 底から横へ伸びている、この白い部分です。まだお湯は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 疑わしい線の位置とお湯を入れていないことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this white part extending sideways from the bottom. I haven't added hot water yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the suspicious line's position and say no hot water has been added. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。確認用に取り分け、体験には別の茶碗を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We'll set it aside for checking and use another bowl for the activity.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取り替えていただけると助かります。新しい茶碗はどちらの手で支えればいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換を依頼し茶碗を支える手の使い方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd appreciate a replacement. Which hand should I use to support the new bowl?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request an exchange and ask how to support the bowl with your hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 右手で持ち、左の手のひらを底に添えてみてください。今の持ち方で安定していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Try holding it with your right hand and placing your left palm under the base. Does your current grip feel stable?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、両手なら安定します。ただ、茶碗を回す方向をもう一度見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち方の安定を伝え回す方向の実演を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it's stable with both hands. But please show me again which direction to turn the bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the grip is stable and request a demonstration of the turning direction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私の動きをゆっくり見てください。力を入れすぎず、少しずつ回しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Watch my movement slowly. Let's turn it little by little without using too much force.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 動きを見てから試すとよくわかりました。使った茶碗はここに戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 実演への理解を伝えて使用後の返却場所を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Trying after watching your movement made it clear. May I put the used bowl back here?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you understood the demonstration and confirm where to return the used bowl. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、その盆にお願いします。今日の体験はここまでです、お帰りもお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, on that tray, please. That's the end of today's activity. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その筒状の荷物について、乗車前に確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before boarding, please let us check that tube-shaped piece of luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中には展覧会に出す紙の作品が入っています。長さがあるので、持ち込み方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作品入りの長い筒の持ち込み方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It contains a paper artwork for an exhibition. It's long, so I'd like advice on how to bring it on board.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss bringing aboard a long tube containing artwork. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 長さと幅を教えてください。短くしたり折り畳んだりはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me its length and width. Can you shorten or fold it?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 長さは九十センチ、幅は十センチほどです。作品が傷むので畳めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 筒の寸法と折り畳めない理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's ninety centimeters long and about ten centimeters wide. I can't fold it because the artwork would be damaged.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the tube dimensions and explain why it cannot be folded. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 運べるか担当者に確認しますので、荷物を持ったままこちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the staff member whether it can be carried. Please wait here holding your luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: かしこまりました。筒を立てて持てば、ほかの方の足元には出ないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待機に応じ通行を妨げない持ち方を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Certainly. I think if I hold the tube upright, it won't project into other people's foot space.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Agree to wait and suggest a way of holding it without obstructing passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者から、通路や扉をふさがずに持つよう案内がありました。混雑した場合は次の便をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member says to hold it without blocking the aisle or doors. If it's crowded, we'll direct you to the next service.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の便が混んでいたら、一本後でも構いません。荷物を置きっぱなしにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 混雑時は次の便を待ち荷物を離さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: If this service is crowded, the one after is fine. I won't leave the luggage unattended.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait for the next service if crowded and keep the luggage with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。乗り口に進む前に、筒のふたが閉まっているかも確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. Before moving to the boarding entrance, please also check the tube's lid is closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふたを留め直しました。乗る順番が来るまで、筒を抱えてここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 筒のふたを留め直し案内まで待機すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've secured the lid again. I'll wait here holding the tube until it's my turn to board.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Resecure the tube lid and say you will wait for guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、順番にご案内します。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll guide you in order. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は昨日の続きからですが、始める前に畝の目印を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Today we'll continue from yesterday, but look at the row marker before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 記録には三列目の途中とありますが、赤いひもは四列目にあります。どちらから摘めばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 茶畑の記録と赤いひもの位置の食い違いを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The record says partway through the third row, but the red string is in the fourth row. Where should I start picking?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the discrepancy between the tea-field record and red string position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ひもが移動した可能性がありますね。今は摘まずに、昨日の記録をこちらへ持ってきてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The string may have moved. Don't pick for now; please bring yesterday's record here.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。三列目の北側を残したと書いてあり、作業者の名前もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中断して前日の未完了範囲を記した紙を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the paper. It says the north side of the third row was left, and it has the worker's name too.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Pause and hand over the paper recording yesterday's unfinished area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その人に確認しました。三列目の北側が残りで、四列目のひもは通路の目印だそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked with that person. The north side of the third row remains, and the fourth-row string marks the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 列を数える起点は、物置側で合っていますか。逆から数えると違う場所になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 畝の番号を数える起点を農家に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is the starting point for counting the rows the storage-shed side? Counting from the other side gives a different place.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with the farmer which end the row numbering starts from. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 物置側から数えます。私と一緒に三列目まで歩いて、位置を合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We count from the storage shed. Let's walk together to the third row and match the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここが三列目ですね。摘み終わった部分との境目は、この低くなっているところですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象の畝と摘み終わった境目を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: This is the third row, right? Is this lower section the boundary with the part already picked?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the target row and the boundary of the completed picking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、その先が残りです。終わった範囲は紙にも記録してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the area beyond that remains. Please record the completed area on paper too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業後は北側のどこまで進んだか、物置側からの列番号と一緒に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 次の作業者が迷わない形で進捗を記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: After working, I'll record how far along the north side I reached, together with the row number counted from the shed.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will record progress clearly so the next worker will not be confused. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 位置がそろいましたね。私は戻りますので、何かあれば呼んでください、それでは。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've matched the location. I'm going back now; call if anything comes up. See you.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: これから使う包装箱の準備はできていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the packaging boxes for the next work ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 奥の箱の束が濡れています。このまま製品を入れていいか、判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 包装箱の濡れを報告し使用可否を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The bundle of boxes at the back is wet. I can't judge whether it's okay to put products in them as they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report wet packaging boxes and ask whether they may be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 濡れた箱は使わず、その束と近くの箱を分けてください。水が落ちている場所は見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't use wet boxes. Separate that bundle and the nearby boxes. Can you see where water is dripping?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 上の配管の下に水滴があります。床にも広がっているので、近づかずに指さして報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 配管下の水滴と床の状況を離れた場所から報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are drops under the pipe above. Water is spreading on the floor too, so I'll report it by pointing from a distance without approaching.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report drops under the pipe and the floor condition from a distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 私が責任者に知らせます。濡れていない束にも影響がないか確認してから使いましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell the supervisor. Let's check whether even the unwet bundles are affected before using them.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見た目が乾いている隣の束も、いったん使用を保留するということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 隣の乾いた束も使用保留になることを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So we're also holding off using the adjacent bundle that looks dry, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the neighboring dry-looking bundle is also on hold. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。保留の表示を付けて、ほかの人が持っていかないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Put on a hold label so others don't take them.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示には発見した時刻と、配管の下で水滴があったことを書きます。ほかに必要な情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保留表示の記録内容を提案し追加項目を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll write the discovery time and the drops under the pipe on the label. Is any other information needed?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Suggest what to record on the hold label and ask about additional details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 箱の種類と束の数も書いてください。配管の確認は担当者に任せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also write the box type and number of bundles. Leave the pipe inspection to the responsible staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ種類が三束あります。記録を添え、使える箱の指示を受けるまで包装を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 箱の束数を伝え包装を指示まで待つと告げる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are three bundles of the same type. I'll attach the record and wait to package until told which boxes can be used.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the bundle count and say packaging will wait for instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 報告を受け取りました。私は責任者のところへ行きますので、ここで待っていてください、それでは。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've received the report. I'm going to the supervisor, so please wait here. See you shortly.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈り物用のお茶でしょうか。お包みする数を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is the tea for gifts? How many packages would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人に贈りますが、好みが違います。一人には渋みの少ないお茶を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人への茶の贈り物を相談し一人の好みを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm giving it to two people, but they have different tastes. I'd like tea with less astringency for one of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss tea gifts for two people and give one person's preference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは香りが軽めのものと、焙煎した香ばしいものです。もう一人の方のお好みはわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here we have one with a light aroma and one with a roasted fragrance. Do you know the other person's preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう一人は香ばしいお茶が好きです。同じ袋にすると渡し間違えそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: もう一人の好みと包装の取り違えへの心配を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The other person likes roasted tea. If they're in the same bag, I might give them to the wrong people.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the other preference and your concern about mixing up the packages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 包装を分けて、外に目印を付けましょうか。お名前を書くこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Shall we wrap them separately and mark the outside? We can write names too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前ではなく、香ばしいほうに丸いシールを付けてください。相手の名前は書かないで大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名前を記載せず丸いシールで茶を区別するよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Instead of names, please put a round sticker on the roasted one. There's no need to write the recipients' names.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request round stickers to distinguish the tea without writing names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 丸いシールはこちらですね。二種類とも小袋にしますか、それとも大袋にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This round sticker, correct? Would you like small or large bags for both kinds?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらも小袋にします。開封後の保存方法がわかる紙を、一つずつ入れていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小袋を選びそれぞれに保存方法の紙を付けてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Small bags for both. Could you put a sheet explaining storage after opening in each one?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose small bags and request storage instructions in each. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれに説明を添えます。こちらの渋みが控えめなものにはシールを付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll add instructions to each. This less-astringent one won't have a sticker.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: シールなしが渋み控えめ、丸いシールが香ばしいお茶ですね。その二袋でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: シールと茶の種類の対応を復唱して注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: No sticker means less astringent, and the round sticker means roasted tea. I'll take those two bags, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat the sticker-to-tea correspondence and finalize the order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かに承りました。お受け取り後も渡す前にお確かめください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please check again after collection and before handing them over. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作業を止めて戻ってきたようですが、どうしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You seem to have stopped work and come back. What happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通行人に向こうの建物への入り方を聞かれました。工事の柵を開けていいかと思い、まず確認に来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物への経路を尋ねられ柵を開ける前に管理者へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: A passerby asked how to get into the building over there. I thought about opening the construction barrier, but came to check first.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the manager before opening a barrier after being asked for a route into a building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 柵を自分で開けてはいけません。通行の案内は誘導担当に引き継いでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mustn't open the barrier yourself. Pass route guidance to the traffic guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 誘導担当は入口の青いベストの方ですか。私は担当者の顔をまだ覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通行誘導の担当者の見分け方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is that the person in the blue vest at the entrance? I haven't learned the staff member's face yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check how to identify the person responsible for directing people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は山田さんです。青いベストだけで決めず、無線で名前を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today it's Yamada. Rather than deciding from the blue vest alone, I'll confirm the name by radio.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その方が確認できるまで、通行人には柵の外で待っていただきます。待つ場所も指定できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 担当者の確認まで待ってもらう場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Until that person is confirmed, I'll ask the passerby to wait outside the barrier. Can you specify where they should wait too?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask where the passerby should wait until the staff member is identified. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歩行者用の待機場所へ案内してください。車道や資材置き場には誘導しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please guide them to the pedestrian waiting area. Don't direct them to the roadway or materials-storage area.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黄色の線の内側にある待機場所ですね。建物の入口までの経路は山田さんから説明してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 待機場所を復唱し経路の説明を誘導担当へ任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The waiting area inside the yellow line, correct? I'll leave the route explanation to the building entrance to Yamada.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the waiting location and leave route guidance to the responsible guide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 山田さんが来ました。どの建物に行きたいのか、ご本人から聞いてもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yamada is here. Let's have them ask the person directly which building they want.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では引き継いだことを確かめてから、私は元の作業場所へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通行人の引継ぎを確かめて自分の作業へ戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll confirm the handover is complete before returning to my original work area.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the passerby handover before returning to your work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの対応は引き受けました。気をつけて作業場所へ戻ってください、それでは。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've taken over here. Please return carefully to your work area. See you.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文がお決まりになりましたら伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll take your order when you've decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 揚げ物の盛り合わせを考えていますが、私は卵アレルギーがあります。衣に卵を使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを伝えて盛り合わせの衣の材料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm considering the mixed fried platter, but I have an egg allergy. Does the coating contain egg?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and ask about the mixed platter's coating ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理担当に確認しました。今日の盛り合わせの衣には卵を使っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've checked with the cooking staff. Today's mixed platter coating contains egg.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 衣を外せば食べられる、とは判断できないですよね。この盛り合わせは私の分には頼みません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 衣を外すだけでは判断できないと確認し自分の注文を取りやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We can't judge it edible just by removing the coating, can we? I won't order this platter for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that removing coating alone does not establish suitability and cancel your own platter order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、衣を外しても安全とは言えません。同席の方のお料理はどうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct, we can't say it's safe even with the coating removed. What about your companion's food?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は盛り合わせを一人分注文します。私は未開封の瓶入りの水だけにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人の料理と自分の未開封の瓶入り水を区別して頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend will order one serving of the platter. I'd like only an unopened bottle of water for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Order your friend's food separately from your own unopened bottled water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。料理を取り分ける皿は、友人の方だけにお出ししますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Shall we provide a sharing plate only for your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、私の前に取り皿は置かないでください。水の瓶は開けずに持ってきてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の取り皿を不要とし水を開栓せず出すよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please don't put a sharing plate in front of me. Bring the water bottle without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you do not need a sharing plate and ask for the water to be served unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: かしこまりました。会計はお二人分を一緒にしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Would you like one bill for both people?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料理と私の水は別会計にしてください。食べるものを確認できなかったので、私はここでは食事をしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料理と水の別会計を頼み自分は食事しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please bill the food and my water separately. I couldn't confirm something I can eat, so I won't eat a meal here.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request separate bills for food and water and say you will not eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 別会計で承りました。お帰りの際は伝票をそれぞれお持ちください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-KOYA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Separate bills, understood. Please each bring your own bill when leaving. Thank you.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お客様、柵の向こうへは入らないでください。何か落とされましたか。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please don't go beyond the fence. Did you drop something?

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 風で帽子が飛んでしまいました。岩の手前に見える青い帽子です。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 帽子が飛んだ位置と色を係員に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: The wind blew my hat away. It's the blue hat visible in front of the rocks.
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the attendant the location and color of the blown-away hat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見えましたが、今は波がかかっています。ご自身で取りに行くのは危険です。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can see it, but waves are reaching that spot now. Going to get it yourself is dangerous.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 泳ぐつもりはありませんが、あの場所も入れないのですね。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 遊泳しなくても立入制限があるか確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wasn't planning to swim, but I still can't enter that area, correct?
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check that entry is restricted even without swimming. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、足元が滑りやすい場所です。回収できるか、担当者に相談します。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Correct, the footing is slippery. I'll ask the responsible staff member whether it can be retrieved.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 急いで取らなくて大丈夫です。帽子より安全を優先してください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 回収を急がず係員の安全を優先すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: There's no need to rush to get it. Please prioritize safety over the hat.
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say not to rush retrieval and prioritize the staff member's safety. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。お連れの方はどちらでお待ちですか。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Where is your companion waiting?

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 子どもがパラソルの下にいます。私もそこへ戻って待てますか。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子どもの待つ場所へ戻ってよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: My child is under the parasol. May I go back there and wait too?
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can return to where your child is waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そちらでお待ちください。確認が済んだら、私が声をかけます。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please wait there. I'll speak to you once the check is complete.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、青いパラソルのところに戻ります。動くときは先にお知らせします。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 待機場所と移動時の連絡を取り決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll return to the blue parasol. I'll tell you before moving anywhere else.
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree on the waiting place and notification if moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: わかりました、青いパラソルですね。それでは、足元に気をつけてお戻りください。
DLG-SC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood, the blue parasol. Please watch your step going back.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三〇二号室の清掃が止まっていますね。何か見つかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Cleaning in room three-oh-two has stopped. Did you find something?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 机に携帯電話があり、充電器もつながったままです。まだ触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 携帯電話と充電器の発見状況を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's a mobile phone on the desk with its charger still connected. I haven't touched it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report the phone and charger as found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: そのままにしてください。退室の記録をフロントに確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please leave them as they are. I'll check the checkout record with the front desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 画面に名前が出ていますが、報告にその名前も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 画面の個人名を報告すべきか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's a name on the screen. Is that name needed in the report too?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether the personal name on the screen needs reporting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 画面を詳しく見る必要はありません。部屋番号と見つけた場所で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You don't need to examine the screen closely. We'll check using the room number and discovery location.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、三〇二号室の机の上と伝えます。写真も撮らずに待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 部屋番号と位置だけを伝え撮影を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll say it's on the desk in room three-oh-two. I'll wait without taking photos either.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report only the room number and position and avoid photography. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それで十分です。確認まで、この部屋の清掃を中断してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: That's enough. Please suspend cleaning this room until we've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 次の部屋へ移りたいのですが、清掃用のカートは廊下のどこに置きましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 清掃中断後のカートの置き場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like to move to the next room. Where in the hallway should I put the cleaning cart?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Discuss the cart's location after pausing cleaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 通路を塞がない所へ一緒に移しましょう。次の担当室もここで確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let's move it together somewhere that doesn't block the passage. We'll check your next assigned room here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: カートを移してから担当表を見直します。三〇二号室の再開は連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 担当表の再確認と清掃再開の連絡待ちを約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll review the assignment sheet after moving the cart. I'll wait for word before resuming room three-oh-two.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Promise to recheck the assignment sheet and wait for notification to resume cleaning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お願いします。確認できたらこちらから連絡しますので、それでは次のお部屋へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Please do. We'll contact you once we've checked, so go on to the next room for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらの魚をご覧ですか。丸ごと調理するご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you looking at this fish? Are you planning to cook it whole?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 宿の焼き網が小さいので、そのまま載せられるか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 宿の小さい焼き網に魚が収まるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The grill at my accommodation is small, so I'm worried whether it will fit as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether the fish fits the accommodation's small grill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 網のおおよその幅はわかりますか。大きい魚なら切り分ける方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you know the approximate grill width? For a large fish, cutting it up is also an option.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 幅は二十センチほどです。二人で食べる分を切り身にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 網の幅と人数を示して切り分けを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's about twenty centimeters wide. Could you cut enough for two people into portions?
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Give the grill width and number of people and request portions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この魚なら切り身にできます。頭と骨もお持ち帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: This fish can be portioned. Would you like to take the head and bones too?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 汁物を作る道具はないので、切り身だけ包んでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 調理設備に合わせ頭と骨が不要だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I don't have the equipment to make soup, so I'd like only the portions wrapped.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say the head and bones are unnecessary given the cooking facilities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: かしこまりました。調理するまで冷やしておけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. Can you keep it cold until cooking?

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 部屋に冷蔵庫はありますが、売場から戻るまで四十分くらいかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 冷蔵設備と帰路の所要時間を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's a refrigerator in the room, but it takes about forty minutes to return from the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the refrigeration facilities and journey time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 持ち帰りの保冷方法を確認して包みます。焼くときは中まで十分に加熱してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: We'll check how to keep it cold on the trip and wrap it. When grilling, please heat it thoroughly all the way through.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 保冷の案内を聞いてから持ち帰ります。宿に着いたらすぐ冷蔵庫へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 保冷案内を聞き帰宿後すぐ冷蔵すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll take it home after hearing the cooling instructions. I'll put it in the refrigerator immediately when I reach my accommodation.
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Hear the cooling instructions and say you will refrigerate immediately after returning. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、切り身を用意します。お受け取りの後は寄り道を控えて、どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-WKY-SHIRAHAMA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I'll prepare the portions. After collecting them, please avoid detours and take care going back.
